item.title: Visual artist Amadeo Carvalho explores Black identity
item.description: From Cape Verde to London and beyond, Amadeo Carvalho is a self-taught, London-based contemporary visual artist putting Black identity, memory and heritage at the heart of his work. Blending painting, poetry and photography, his art explores the stories, silences and connections that shape who we are. This weekend, his powerful collection "Portraits of Absence" arrives at the AKAA Art Fair here in Paris, where it will be exhibited by the curatorial platform Casa Vicência. He spoke to us in Perspective

item.title: Egypt mulls joining Saudi Arabia in war against Houthis
item.description: Egypt may be about to join the war against Houthis. Story by Camille Corcoran.

item.title: AI on the ballot? Voters in US midterms revolt against data centres
item.description: Two weeks out from the US midterm elections, there's bipartisan pushback against data centres that suck the water and power out of communities. Just two years ago, ChatGPT was still a brand-new thing, and AI was admired with awe by most voters.
